description: Detailed responsibility map; Clever entries are questions/expectations pending provider confirmation.

items.title: Account identity and role
items.educateos: EducateOS resolves a principal by district, trusted issuer and stable subject. Class roles come from enrollment, not an email match.
items.google: Google OAuth supplies an account identity. Classroom membership supplies teacher/student course roles. Teacher connector OAuth is demonstrated; full district sign-in/roster linking is still open.
items.clever: Confirm verified Clever subject (multi_role_user_id/sub), district claims and multi-role behavior; provide admin, teacher, student and non-member logins.
items.boundary: A Clever identity and a Google identity require verified linking to the same district principal. SSO alone grants no Google content access.

items.title: District, school, term and class structure
items.educateos: The local directory models districts, schools, terms, catalog courses and taught offerings.
items.google: Classroom courses represent taught classes. EducateOS configuration supplies schools, grade bands and terms for this roster path. A selected-course list separates districts sharing a Workspace domain.
items.clever: Enable and confirm districts, schools, terms, courses and sections with district-approved fields. Clever sections should map to taught offerings; catalog courses stay distinct.
items.boundary: Google Classroom course and Clever catalog course are different model objects. Do not map them by name alone.

items.title: Who belongs to which class
items.educateos: EducateOS uses active student/staff enrollments to authorize class views and operations.
items.google: Classroom teacher/student lists supply course membership. Real single-course reads exist; complete deployed district sync and stable identity acceptance remain open.
items.clever: Provide users and section teacher/student membership, secondary teacher/staff/multi-role fixtures and a second isolated district.
items.boundary: Enrollment is authorization context. It does not grant a file ACL, mailbox, another learner’s work or teacher grading authority.

items.title: Roster preview, apply and removal
items.educateos: Both adapters use the shared import pipeline: validation, quarantine, preview, apply and a large-removal hold. Failed runs preserve prior successful state.
items.google: The Google roster path performs complete polling. Its source and district wiring exist; full live preview/apply/scheduled acceptance is pending.
items.clever: Confirm API version plus roster entitlement. Enable events with documented retention/cursor/removal semantics, or agree complete-refresh cadence.
items.boundary: Clever event changes describe roster data, not Classroom submissions or grading. Harness tests are not a real-provider sync result.

items.title: Role-aware launch
items.educateos: EducateOS routes the signed-in principal to the district and the appropriate app context.
items.google: Google-connected Workshop sessions and separate Google Classroom pages have real evidence. This does not prove a whole-district Google launch or identity setup.
items.clever: Confirm shared portal launch/redirect registration, district claims, stable user ID and role choice. Test each role and wrong-district denial.
items.boundary: Portal implementation exists, but current live Clever launch acceptance is open. A persona selector in the offline demo is synthetic authentication.

items.title: Instructor creation, agents and gadgets
items.educateos: Teacher Studio supplies activities, resources, feedback and class tools. Workshop supplies code-mode agents, resource capabilities, gadgets and reusable blueprints.
items.google: The connector reads the real task/rubric and supports app-owned coursework actions. Science and Algebra gadgets render worksheet, slides, local quiz and discussion, with PDF/PPTX exports.
items.clever: Roster and launch context can put an instructor in the right district/class. Ask whether any separate Clever product adds content context.
items.boundary: EducateOS creates the experience. Clever roster access is not a native Google Doc/Slides/Sheets or authoring API. The offline district demo has AI off.

items.title: Individual learner work
items.educateos: Learning Home supplies versioned learner artifacts/submissions. The separate personal Classroom capability supplies only published work and own submission state.
items.google: Real work/turn-in and 18/20 visibility were demonstrated in Google Classroom. EducateOS student API is deployed; its new personal gadget still needs live OAuth/approval/turn-in acceptance.
items.clever: Provide verified learner identity and section membership. Keep individual Google OAuth and the one-course capability separate from the district roster token.
items.boundary: A teacher presentation filter cannot protect students. Each learner creates their own blueprint instance; upload/answer authoring and grade display are absent from the student connector API.

items.title: Teacher review and grade return
items.educateos: EducateOS owns assessment decisions, official grades and feedback-release policy for its native activities. External grade publication uses a supported LMS route.
items.google: The teacher-approved Science 18/20 and return were read back from Google and seen by the learner. Google restricts writes to the app’s project-owned coursework. Rubric criterion grades cannot be published through its API.
items.clever: Confirm whether any additional Clever product covers learning/grade context; otherwise retain Google or an LMS/LTI connector for those operations.
items.boundary: Do not promise Clever submission or grade-write APIs. Native EducateOS grading in the synthetic demo is different evidence from a Google grade-return transaction.

items.title: Documents, data, calendars and communication
items.educateos: Exact resource bindings support reading guides, lab data, native presentations, scoped libraries, agenda and private communication assistants.
items.google: Fourteen resource kinds are declared. Beyond the demonstrated Classroom/gadget story, native Workspace teaching recipes remain unrehearsed. Drive supports metadata/native reads, not general upload/share/delete.
items.clever: Use district identity/membership to inform intended audiences. Ask which separately approved app/content integrations Clever recommends.
items.boundary: Clever consent does not grant Google OAuth scopes or file/calendar/Chat membership. Gmail and whole-account Chat belong outside learner templates.

items.title: Guardian access
items.educateos: EducateOS invitations, identity approval and a confirmed relationship scope expose a child’s classes and released results, not submissions or unrelated children.
items.google: Guardian relationships are not supplied by the demonstrated Google connector. The synthetic product demo seeds an EducateOS-approved guardian relationship.
items.clever: Confirm any supported family/relationship product separately, its consent/field contract and role limitations. The current Clever adapter does not import contacts as guardians.
items.boundary: Never infer a guardian relationship from a shared email, basic identity scope, contact record or roster membership.

items.title: District control, cost and recovery
items.educateos: District policies, approved resources/actions, release signatures, feedback visibility and AI-governance mechanisms belong to EducateOS. Educational records stay with the district or its approved provider.
items.google: Real Google approvals demonstrate write control and readback. Full revoke/reconnect/outage and broader Plus acceptance remain open. The offline product demo has no funded AI or provider traffic.
items.clever: Confirm consent/sharing revocation, token rotation, quotas, event recovery and support ownership; supply negative fixtures to validate our handling.
items.boundary: School/district membership is only one policy input. It does not authorize model access, budgets, publication or unrestricted provider data.

items.title: Blueprints and safe distribution
items.educateos: A blueprint carries reviewed source and required resource shapes. A new instance gets its own storage, history and authorized bindings.
items.google: Teacher formats are demonstrated and source is included. Personal student companion source is implemented; fresh two-student install/update acceptance remains open.
items.clever: Use supported Clever sign-in/launch to simplify onboarding and select the intended class; confirm any distribution program or review requirement.
items.boundary: Do not distribute a live teacher workspace or its credentials. Copying code does not transfer Google file permissions or provider consent.
